notes: Scorable benchmark targets with documented bugs. See benchmarks.md for commits, scope and the full known-bug list. Each prompt points the skill at a cloned corpus target; expected_output lists the documented bugs a run should surface (recall) without flagging the paired secure variant (precision). Re-pin commits before scoring.

evals.name: sec-template-core-anchor
evals.prompt: Run rust auditor on the vulnerable programs in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} (Ubuntu-Technologies/solana-security-template @cb48608): signer-authorization, owner-check, account-type-mismatch, insecure-init, duplicate-accounts, pda-security, account-close, arithmetic-overflow.
evals.expected_output: High findings matching the documented class per module: missing signer (B1), missing owner (B2), type cosplay (B3), re-init (B4), duplicate mutable accounts (B6), non-canonical/predictable PDA (B7), manual-close revival (B8), unchecked overflow (B10). No finding on the paired secure.rs variants.

evals.name: sec-template-new-classes
evals.prompt: Run rust auditor on the account-griefing, authority-transfer, account-reloading, remaining-accounts and amm/buggy-amm programs in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} (solana-security-template @cb48608).
evals.expected_output: Leads/findings for: account-creation DoS via predictable init PDA (B13); single-step authority transfer (B14); stale-after-CPI read (B11); unvalidated remaining_accounts (B5-adjacent); and in buggy-amm weak PDA seeds (B7) + unchecked overflow (B10) + missing slippage / ignored min_out (B16).

evals.name: sec-patterns-anchor-and-pinocchio
evals.prompt: Run rust auditor on the Anchor and Pinocchio vulnerable variants in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} (Abdullateef1x/solana-security-patterns @4646ebe).
evals.expected_output: Each pattern flagged in both anchor/ and pinocchio/ vulnerable.rs: missing signer (B1), missing has_one link (B1/B7), unsafe arithmetic (B10), insecure PDA (B7), CPI authority misuse / user-controlled transfer authority (B5). Tests account-map + native/Pinocchio manual-validation review; not the --poc build path (repo may not build).

evals.name: escrow-pinocchio-destination-validation
evals.prompt: Run rust auditor on the p-escrow Pinocchio program in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} (solana-security-template @cb48608).
evals.expected_output: A High finding that the refund destination is not validated against the stored maker, letting a refund be redirected to an attacker (destination/recipient validation, B15/L2) — a native/Pinocchio manual-validation miss.
assertions: refund destination not checked against escrow.maker

evals.name: halborn-ctf-native-noise-check
evals.prompt: Run rust auditor on the HalbornCTF_Rust_Solana native program in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} (HalbornSecurity/CTFs @684f1af).
evals.expected_output: A clean run on a native (non-Anchor) program: the account-map and native/Pinocchio review produce sane leads over hand-rolled account handling without crashing. Bugs are undisclosed (CTF); scored for robustness and plausible leads, not against a fixed answer key.
